title.en: Electric Field Lines of Point Charges
title.hi: बिंदु आवेशों की विद्युत क्षेत्र रेखाएं
title.hinglish: Point Charges ki Electric Field Lines

description.en: Electric field lines originate from positive charges and terminate at negative charges. For an isolated positive charge, they extend radially outwards to infinity. For an isolated negative charge, they come radially inwards from infinity.
description.hi: विद्युत क्षेत्र रेखाएं धनात्मक आवेशों से उत्पन्न होती हैं और ऋणात्मक आवेशों पर समाप्त होती हैं। एक विलगित धनावेश के लिए, वे अरीय रूप से बाहर की ओर अनंत तक फैली होती हैं। एक विलगित ऋणावेश के लिए, वे अनंत से अरीय रूप से अंदर की ओर आती हैं।
description.hinglish: Positive charge se electric field lines bahar ki taraf (radially outward) nikalti hain, aur negative charge me andar ki taraf (radially inward) aati hain.

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 600 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Positive Charge -->
  <g transform="translate(150, 150)">
    <!-- Field Lines -->
    <g stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrowhead-blue)">
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="100" y2="0" />
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="-100" y2="0" />
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="100" />
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="-100" />
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="70.7" y2="70.7" />
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="-70.7" y2="-70.7" />
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="70.7" y2="-70.7" />
      <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="-70.7" y2="70.7" />
    </g>
    <!-- Charge Body -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="20" fill="#ef4444" />
    <text x="0" y="8" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">+</text>
    <text x="0" y="140" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" fill="#374151" text-anchor="middle">q > 0 (Radially Outward)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Negative Charge -->
  <g transform="translate(450, 150)">
    <!-- Field Lines -->
    <g stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrowhead-blue-rev)">
      <line x1="100" y1="0" x2="30" y2="0" />
      <line x1="-100" y1="0" x2="-30" y2="0" />
      <line x1="0" y1="100" x2="0" y2="30" />
      <line x1="0" y1="-100" x2="0" y2="-30" />
      <line x1="70.7" y1="70.7" x2="21.2" y2="21.2" />
      <line x1="-70.7" y1="-70.7" x2="-21.2" y2="-21.2" />
      <line x1="70.7" y1="-70.7" x2="21.2" y2="-21.2" />
      <line x1="-70.7" y1="70.7" x2="-21.2" y2="21.2" />
    </g>
    <!-- Inner lines to connect smoothly -->
    <g stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2">
      <line x1="30" y1="0" x2="0" y2="0" />
      <line x1="-30" y1="0" x2="0" y2="0" />
      <line x1="0" y1="30" x2="0" y2="0" />
      <line x1="0" y1="-30" x2="0" y2="0" />
      <line x1="21.2" y1="21.2" x2="0" y2="0" />
      <line x1="-21.2" y1="-21.2" x2="0" y2="0" />
      <line x1="21.2" y1="-21.2" x2="0" y2="0" />
      <line x1="-21.2" y1="21.2" x2="0" y2="0" />
    </g>
    <!-- Charge Body -->
    <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="20" fill="#2563eb" />
    <text x="0" y="6" font-family="Arial" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" fill="white" text-anchor="middle">-</text>
    <text x="0" y="140" font-family="Arial" font-size="16" fill="#374151" text-anchor="middle">q < 0 (Radially Inward)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Arrow markers def -->
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrowhead-blue" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#3b82f6" />
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrowhead-blue-rev" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="1" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto">
      <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#3b82f6" />
    </marker>
  </defs>
</svg>
